0|fc5eb4a84e4c063e75a6a6e92308e9533c0f19b5|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"btf: Avoid weak external references
If the BTF code is enabled in the build configuration
BTF markers are guaranteed to exist. Only when CONFIG_DEBUG_INFO_BTF=n
the references in btf_parse_vmlinux() will remain unsatisfied
on the weak linkage of the external references to avoid breaking the
build.
Avoid GOT based relocations to these markers in the final executable by
dropping the weak attribute and instead
ERR_PTR(-ENOENT) directly if CONFIG_DEBUG_INFO_BTF is not enabled to
begin with.  The compiler will drop any subsequent references to
__start_BTF and __stop_BTF in that case
Note that Clang will notice that taking the address of __start_BTF can
no longer yield NULL
column2: so testing for that condition becomes unnecessary.
